Roguelike.def: Short runs with random levels; death resets the run.

Metroidvania.def: One large connected map that opens as you gain abilities.

Platformer.def: Jumping and movement through levels is the core.

Puzzle.def: Solving set problems with logic is the core.

Shooter.def: Aiming and shooting guns is the core.

Melee Action.def: Close-up combat: swords, fists, dodges, parries.

Fighting.def: One-on-one or small-arena duels with combos.

RPG.def: Character stats, levels, parties, and quests.

Open World.def: A large free world to roam, with side content.

Survival Craft.def: Gather, craft, and build to stay alive.

Horror.def: Fear and dread are the core experience.

Builder & Management.def: Build and run a base, city, colony, factory, or business.

Life Sim.def: Daily life: farm, work, make friends, decorate.

Strategy.def: Command units or plan moves: RTS, turn-based, tower defense.

Deckbuilder & Cards.def: Build and play a deck of cards.

Narrative.def: Story and choices are the core: visual novels, detective, adventure.

Stealth & Immersive Sim.def: Sneak, use systems, and solve problems many ways.

Sandbox.def: Free play with tools and physics, few goals.

Party & Multiplayer.def: Built around playing with or against other people.
